newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish one-yr, 18-mo bill yields seen unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spanish one-yr, 18-mo bill yields seen unchanged.

text.p: Spanish one-year and 18-month Treasury bill yields are expected to remain unchanged at Wednesday's repurchase auction with both seen at around the 4.95 percent level set two weeks ago, dealers said on Tuesday.
"Things have not changed a lot in the last two weeks and it seems there is little scope from the 4.95 percent of the last auction," a dealer in Madrid said.
On July 9, both one-year and 18-month bills set a marginal yield at 4.95 percent.
However, one Madrid-based dealer said there could be a very slight fluctuation in yields on Wednesday.
"In the 18-month (bill) it's possible to see yields falling to 4.93 percent, while in the year (bill) you could see a yield at 4.96," the dealer said.
On the grey market, although trade was not very active, 18-month bills were trading at around 4.91/94 percent. One-year bills were not traded.
